==Polish==

===Pronunciation===
{{pl-pr|a=Pl-#.ogg<text:#>;LL-Q809 (pol)-Olaf-#.wav<text:#>;LL-Q809 (pol)-Olaf-# się.wav<text:~>|hh=miedź|mp=#,miéć}}

===Etymology 1===
{{etymon|pl|id=have|:inh|zlw-opl:mieć|tree=1|text=+}}

====Verb====
{{pl-verb|impf|freq=miewać}}

# {{lb|pl|transitive}} to [[have]]
#: {{uxi|pl|'''Mam''' kota.|I '''have''' a cat.}}
#: {{uxi|pl|'''Mam''' daleko do szkoły.|It's a long way to school for me.|lit=I '''have''' [it] far to school.}}
# {{lb|pl|intransitive}} to [[be]] some age
#: {{uxi|pl|'''Mam''' 22 lata.|I am 22 years old.|lit=I '''have''' 22 years.}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive}} {{ng|used as a semantically weak verb with some nouns}}
#: {{uxi|pl|'''Mam bzika''' na ich punkcie.|'''I'm crazy''' about them.}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive|colloquial}} to [[have]], to have [[sex]] with
#: {{uxi|pl|Chyba nigdy chłopa nie '''miała'''.|She probably never '''had''' a man.}}
#: {{syn|pl|Thesaurus:uprawiać seks}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive}} to [[consider]] someone as something {{+obj|pl|:za(acc)}}
#: {{uxi|pl|'''Miałem''' Cię za przyjaciela.|I '''considered''' you my friend.}}
#: {{uxi|pl|'''Masz się''' za lepszego?|You '''think''' you are better?|lit=You '''consider yourself''' better?}}
# {{lb|pl|with the passive participle}} to [[have]] {{gl|e.g. to have something (that is) cooked}}
#: {{coi|pl|'''Mam''' cały wieczór zaplanowany.|I '''have''' the whole evening planned.}}
# {{lb|pl|auxiliary|intransitive}} {{ng|expresses obligation}}; to be [[supposed to]], [[must]], to [[have to]], to [[need|need to]]; [[should]], [[shall]]
#: {{uxi|pl|'''Mamy''' iść na zakupy.|We're '''supposed to''' go shopping.}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Czy '''mam''' zaparzyć herbatę?|'''Should/Shall''' I brew some tea?}}
# {{lb|pl|auxiliary|formal|in the past}} {{ng|creates a future in the past}}; [[would]], [[going to|was going to]]
#: {{coi|pl|Ten chłopiec '''miał''' w przyszłości zostać wielkim naukowcem.|This boy '''would''' in the future become a great scientist.}}
# {{lb|pl|auxiliary|intransitive|in the past|evidential}} {{ng|denotes that something might not have happened despite earlier beliefs}}; to be [[supposed to]], [[must]], to [[have to]], to [[need|need to]]
#: {{uxi|pl|System informatyczny '''miał''' obsługiwać klientów.|The IT system '''was supposed to''' serve customers}}
# {{lb|pl|auxiliary|intransitive|in the past|evidential}} {{ng|denotes uncertain, unverified information}}; [[allegedly]], [[supposedly]]
#: {{uxi|pl|Mężczyzna '''miał''' wykrzykiwać obraźliwe hasła.|The man '''was allegedly''' shouting obscenities.}}
#* {{quote-book|pl|title=Polska Piastów|author=Paweł Jasienica|year=1966|location=Warsaw|publisher=Państwowy Instytut Wydawniczy|edition=3|page=48|text=Zapisana przez Galla legenda głosi, że  Piasto był chłopem i mieszkał na podgrodziu. Polanie, zrażeni okrucieństwami poprzedniego władcy ― Popiela ― mieli zrzucić go z tronu i obrać na księcia Ziemowita.|translation=The legend recorded by Gallus says that Piast was a peasant who lived in a ''podgrodzie''. The Polans, disgusted by the cruelties of the previous ruler, Popiel, '''supposedly''' deposed him and elected Ziemowit duke.}}
# {{lb|pl|intransitive}} to [[feel]] something
#: {{uxi|pl|'''Miałem''' do niego '''żal''' o to.|I '''resented''' him for that.}}
# {{lb|pl|reflexive-się}} to [[fare]] {{gl|to be in any state, or pass through any experience, good or bad}}
#: {{uxi|pl|[[jak się masz|Jak '''się masz'''?]]|How are you?}}
# {{lb|pl|reflexive-się}} to [[appear]], to [[bode]] {{+obj|pl|:ku(dat)}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Dzień '''miał się''' ku końcowi.|The day '''was coming to''' an end.}}
# {{lb|pl|reflexive-się}} to be in [[relation]] to something {{+obj|pl|:do(gen)<to what>}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Jak to '''się ma''' do tematu?|How '''is''' this '''related''' to the subject?}}
# {{lb|pl|reflexive-się|obsolete}} to [[head]] somewhere {{+obj|pl|:ku(dat)/:w(acc)}}
# {{lb|pl|reflexive-się|Middle Polish}} to [[behave]]
#: {{syn|pl|[[zachowywać]] [[się]]}}
#: {{syn|pl|działać}}
# {{lb|pl|reflexive-się|Middle Polish}} to [[address]], to [[turn]] towards
# {{lb|pl|reflexive-się|Middle Polish}} to [[function]]
# {{lb|pl|reflexive-się|Middle Polish}} to be [[have|had]]

=====Usage notes=====
* While the passive participle {{m|pl|miany}} is attested and used in passive constructions, this is generally rare. Impersonal constructions using {{m|pl|się}} are usually preferred for a similar use.
